correctness.rationale: For connected spanning K2,k all leaf statuses are A-only, B-only or both, with c>=1. Direct BFS payoff-difference reconstruction shows A-only leaf adding B edge gains alpha-2(b+1), B gains alpha-2; double-leaf deletion (when c>=2) gives opposite threshold. All feasible moves thus imply exactly c=1 low-alpha, c=k full-host high-alpha, or balanced a=b=t, c>=2 at alpha=2(t+1). Count stable labeled networks by k*binomial tail, plus full host and balanced multinomials. Phi=alpha*c+2(a+1)(b+1) changes by the corresponding endpoint threshold, hence strictly increases on every allowed improving move; at most binom(k+1,2)-1 different triples. Independent exhaustive graph-distance/payoff enumeration of all labeled states for k=3,4,5, alpha=1..6 confirms classification, counts and potential signs, including equality boundaries.
